column1: # The steps of a level's start (the calls in In_InitN and In_Game of src/game/Script/InitLevel.c, Om_Init and
# Om_InitOutMap of OutMap.c, InMap_Init and InMap_Start of InMap.c, found by netclass.py --scan in their order):
# File:call, tag, why. Tags: WORLD (once for the world, on the server), PLAYER_ENTER (for each player that enters:
# the startup player, the arrival, the camera, the HUD), DEF (definitions both sides make), GROUP (a group of steps
# whose own steps have rows: it runs where any of them runs). The rail traffic is the server's (stage 2.2,
# include/scrap/viewers.h). A -mp2 client with a split start runs DEF and GROUP steps only (include/scrap/initsteps.h); a row of a function that is no module call names the C function. netclass.py
# counts the rows without a tag.
